parts.text: How do I make the assistant use a local model instead of Gemini?
You can make the assistant use a local model instead of Gemini by setting `OLLAMA_API_BASE` (install.md).

title: CLI reference

# CLI reference

## ask

`docs-assistant ask QUESTION` prints an answer with citation links.

## index

`docs-assistant index --rebuild` drops the search index and builds it again from the docs folder.

title: Install

# Install

## Requirements

Python 3.12 or later.

## Use a local model

Set `OLLAMA_API_BASE` to use a local model instead of Gemini.
